title: New Elizabeth Holmes Documentary Crosses $100M Worldwide
excerpt: The new documentary about Elizabeth Holmes, titled 'You Can See Everything', has surpassed $100 million in global earnings.
body_html:
A new documentary focused on Elizabeth Holmes, titled 'You Can See Everything', has achieved significant financial success, grossing more than $100 million worldwide.

According to reports, the film's impressive milestone comes as its international rollout is only just beginning.
